# DASHBOARD STUDIO SHOWCASE
The ultimate demonstration of capability.

Click any card to explore the widget features.

You can select different templates in the editor to explore styles.
# SWITCHES & BUTTONS
# SMART GAUGES
# LIVE GRAPHS
# PRECISION SLIDERS
# ANIMATED ARROWS AND LINES
# EDIT BOX, LOGS & LISTS

# Interactive Lists & Logs
The list on the left demonstrates both real-time logging and the new **Dynamic Checklist** engine.

- **Interactivity:** Tap checkboxes to toggle states. Supports strikethrough and custom icons.
- **Master Controls:** Use trigger topics to Select All, Clear, or Delete Checked items.
- **Data Formats:** Supports `true|icon|text` strings or full JSON array replacement.
- **Two-Way Sync:** Publish the entire list state back to your platform for full persistence.

**The buttons below are wired via local topics to trigger these actions instantly.**
# RICH TYPOGRAPHY
# ICONS & IMAGES
# TIMEKEEPING
# BATTERY MONITORING
# ADVANCED LAYOUTS

## :ph-stack: Container Grouping
*The panel on the left is created by placing a Container widget **behind** the active switches.*

### :ph-layers: Layering Controls
You can easily manage depth and build beautiful UI cards by using **Send to Back** and **Bring to Front** in the editor to arrange your items!

# Animated arrows and lines
Visualize flows and processes using arrows or lines.

- **Arrows** Drag the two handles to angle the direction.
- **Lines** To create lines, make the "head size" 0.
- **Flow animation** Turn on animate in effects to let it flow.
- Curved lines are supported but animated may impact system performance.

The Trigger Activation Topic of the Menu widget is linked via a local topic to the button's state. When one of these two menu item is selected, the menu closes and automatically deactivates the button.

## :ph-layout: Demo Dashboard
*Preview Dashboard Studio's capabilities.*

* :ph-file-dashed: **Start Fresh:** Reset Canvas, save as `dashboard`, and update your Platform Connection.
* :ph-clock-counter-clockwise: **Restore:** Load `demo` to return to this view at any time.
* :ph-squares-four: **Explore:** Press below button for full widget gallery.

## :ph-radio-button: Selection Groups
Buttons sharing the same Selection Group act like radio buttons: turning one ON automatically turns the others OFF.

## :ph-toggle-right: Toggle Switch
A classic UI element for On/Off states.

## :ph-app-window: Button Style
Rectangular touch target. Supports icons, active states, and glowing borders.

## :ph-palette: Customization
Every color (On, Off, Hover, Icon) can be tweaked individually per widget.

## :ph-lightning: Momentary Mode
The switch automatically resets to the 'Off' state immediately after being released.

# :ph-gauge: Configurable Gauges
*Advanced visualizations with smart formatting.*

* :ph-chart-bar: **Axis & Baselines:** Display smart labels, tick marks, and custom starting values.
* :ph-arrows-in: **Shorten Values:** Automatically compress large numbers (e.g., 1720 to 1.72k).
* :ph-palette: **Dynamic Gradients:** Transition smoothly across Start, Middle, and End colors.
* :ph-layout: **Flexible Layouts:** Position gauges relative to text with independent offsets.
* :ph-activity: **Simulation:** Driven entirely by the internal simulation driver.

> :ph-lightbulb: **Tip:** Experiment with Size Adjustment under Appearance or Offsets to position everything perfectly.

## :ph-layout: Demo Dashboard

Did you know this camera view is technically on Page 2? By assigning the same widgets to multiple pages [1,2], you can create seamless transitions. This allows a button to swap out specific elements while keeping the rest of your dashboard layout perfectly static.

# :ph-chart-line: Graph Widget
The Graph widget lets you plot and compare data series on a shared timeline. Whether you want to monitor room temperatures, track daily solar production against household power consumption, or see when your heating turns on and off, this widget turns raw numbers into clear, readable charts that match your dashboard styling.

## :ph-list-dashes: Legends
